figure_contract.conclusion: GRAFT predicts external-context transcriptional responses and ranks first overall across the twelve declared metrics.

evidence.F3b: Per-context and equal-context-mean Top20 Pearson correlation with the original SD definitions.
evidence.F3c: Twelve-metric average-tie ranks, five-context normalized values, and overall rank.

b_benchmark.csv.definition: Target values: mean and sample SD across three training seeds. Macro values: equal-weight mean and sample SD across five target-cell means.

b_gains.csv.definition: Delta r20 = GRAFT minus source mean; relative gain percent = 100*delta/source mean.

b_points.csv.definition: Target points are training seeds; macro points are five target-cell means.

b_run_metrics.csv.definition: Complete adopted external benchmark scores: ten methods, five contexts, three seeds.

c_metric_ranks.csv.definition: Average-tie ranks among 10 methods, on equal-cell metric means. Lower rank is better; error metrics rank ascending, other metrics descending.

c_metric_values.csv.definition: Three seeds averaged within cell, then five cells equally averaged for 12 declared metrics.

c_normalized_cells.csv.definition: Five cell means per method/metric. Original across-method min-max normalization within cell/metric; error metrics reversed. Values copied without recalibration.

c_overall_ranking.csv.definition: Equal-weight average rank over 12 declared metrics; first-place count counts rank exactly 1.
